title: Final project: build your own training service desk
goal: Demonstrate a connected operator workflow with own data, settings and persistent results.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 7; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: Delivery connects learned actions
paragraphs: The final instance combines catalogs, a request document, input rules and a reproducible report. Complete the workflow without bypassing UI through manual database edits. Extra domains do not add value without requirements and tests. Work identity and provenance distinguish the submission from its starter template.

Use your final copy. Create two distinct customer codes, a third equal-named control, one/two services and the 12 requests. Record actual platform numbers: F1–F12 are observation labels, not required numeric-field input.

sections.title: Connected operator workflow
paragraphs: Use your own installed 1C result and independent controls.

code.output: Each screen traces to persisted values and actual identities.

sections.title: Data should distinguish scenarios
paragraphs: Use 12 requests including zero, multiple statuses and equal names with different references. Identical rows let wrong filters pass accidentally. The dataset must distinguishAND fromOR, detail from groups and minutes from cost. Preserve identities alongside totals to explain each reported row.

Demonstrate opening a customer, selecting it in a request, writing, closing, finding by number, then filtering a report and explaining source documents. Follow your variant’s extra requirements. If using work rows, explicitly specify their relation to the header: automatic totals are absent from the starter.

sections.title: Demonstrate persistence
paragraphs: Create a request, close and reopen it by identity, then restart the session. Changes must persist. Separately show rejected input and absence of a write. A Nexus note is not a 1C infobase: distinguish work-copy references, source files and native execution evidence.

Make your extension in another copy of the accepted core, such as an optional service description or improved form layout. Predict scope first and reconcile earlier documents/report afterward. Do not overwrite your work with a third-party or ready-made solution for a screenshot.

sections.title: Replaced work
paragraphs: Preserve the source and record the actual limitation.

sections.title: Submit a minimal complete package
paragraphs: Submit requirements, your configuration/source, synthetic data, report parameters, check table and recovery proof. Exclude the 1C platform, third-party configurations and licenses. Document environment limitations and unperformed checks. File size and screen count do not replace reproducibility from a fresh copy.

Deliver only own configuration/source, synthetic data description, report settings, checks and recovery instructions. Exclude platform installers/licenses. Studio can preserve/export source, while actual data operations and BSL run in installed 1C.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Topic completion is mistaken for a verified practical capstone. Demonstrate actual records, independent checks and recovery separately.
The accepted source is overwritten during a control change. Create a separately named copy and preserve its provenance and old work.
A local self-report is presented as teacher certification. Record the actual grading boundary, evidence and any assistance.
